retrievalProfile.description: A clean studio portrait featuring a subject in earth-toned streetwear against a stark white background with elegant script typography and subtle swirl graphics.

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body or three-quarter studio portrait of a woman with curly hair wearing a brown bucket hat and skirt, positioned on the right side of a high-key white frame. The left side features a large, elegant script name in deep burgundy, accented by a faint, silver-grey swirling graphic element.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject offset to the right to balance large-scale typography on the left
Monochromatic earth-tone wardrobe contrasting against a pure white void
Fluid, organic lines of the script and swirl graphics echoing the subject's hair texture
High-key lighting creating soft shadows and a clean, commercial look
coreInvariants: Asymmetrical balance between subject and text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is vertically oriented, occupying the right third of the frame, scaled to show from head to mid-thigh.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold burgundy script on the left act as dual anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the dark typography on the left, follows the silver swirl toward the subject's face, and then moves down the vertical line of the body.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space on the left and top creates a breathable, minimalist feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for high-contrast isolation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep chocolate brown and charcoal black in the clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Rich burgundy for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation earth tones paired with a high-value background; the burgundy provides the only saturated punch.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Elegant, slanted formal script with high stroke contrast.
letterConstructionRules: Heavy downstrokes with thin, hair-line upstrokes
Connected lowercase letters with decorative flourishes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'y' features a deep, sweeping descender that curls back toward the start of the word.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single decorative script paired with a non-representational abstract graphic flourish.
graphicDevices: Silver-grey wispy swirl graphic behind the text
Subtle drop shadow on the subject to ground them in the white space

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant 90s script aesthetic.
Provides the necessary formal calligraphic structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a woman with dark curly hair wearing a brown bucket hat and brown skirt, standing against a seamless white background, positioned on the right side of the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large burgundy script name in the center-left negative space, layered over a faint, light-grey abstract swirling line graphic.

verificationChecks: Is the text burgundy and slanted?
Is the subject positioned to the right?
Are the clothes in earth tones?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of brown for clothing
Complexity of the silver swirl graphic
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible despite the script style
Check that the subject does not look 'cut out' but naturally lit
Verify the burgundy color is deep and not bright red
Confirm the asymmetrical balance feels intentional
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + High-Key White Background + Right-Aligned Subject + Left-Aligned Large Script Typography + Earth Tone Palette
